title: Manimo Scene Spec
description: Structured intermediate representation for a Manimo scene. Sits between a natural-language topic request and the final JSX. An LLM fills this spec; a human reviews it; a second LLM pass generates the JSX. Dramatically cheaper to iterate than going straight to code. Note: registry-level metadata such as `concepts` (the list of pedagogical concepts a scene teaches, used for cross-scene search and lesson assembly) lives in motion/scene-manifest.json, NOT in spec files. Specs describe how to render a single scene; the manifest describes what scenes exist and how they relate.

id.description: Kebab-case identifier matching the scene file name, e.g. 'rc-circuit'

title.description: Display title in the scene's language, e.g. 'Lading av en kondensator'

topic.description: One-line topic summary for the scene manifest

prerequisites.description: Scene IDs that should be understood before this one

beats.description: Ordered list of animation beats. Each beat maps to one <Sprite> in the generated JSX.

narration.description: One sentence of spoken narration for this beat (source of truth for TTS)

visuals.description: What should appear on screen during this beat

elements.description: Individual visual elements, in the order they should appear

content.description: The text, formula (Unicode or LaTeX), or path description

delay.description: Seconds after beat start before this element appears

note.description: Optional authoring note for the JSX-generation step
